The '''Outlands''' was a remote region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shiva IV]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] [[K'avor]] was located in the Outlands before its destruction by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
